title: Wukong Framework for Not Safe For Work Detection in Text-to-Image systems
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the technical aspects of detecting general NSFW content in AI-generated images.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the detection of Not Safe For Work (NSFW) content, categorized as Illegal Activity, Hate, Violence, Sexual, Self-harm, Harassment, and Shocking, in text-to-image generation systems.
